summary.zh: Analog Canvas 的外观变体和 chopper：Analog Canvas 自己的包，不属于标准系列。
summary.en: The look variants of Analog Canvas and its chopper: Analog Canvas’s own package, not part of the standard series.

Analog Canvas’s own package, not part of the standard series: its look variants and its chopper, and four definitions of meaning only that bring a file it writes back to it unchanged (part names, label bindings, typesetting, parameter text).

Analog Canvas’s own package, not part of the standard series: its look variants and its chopper, and four definitions of meaning only that bring a file it writes back to it unchanged (part names, label bindings, typesetting and wire crossings, parameter text).

Analog Canvas’s own package, not part of the standard series: its look variants and its chopper, and definitions of meaning only that bring a file it writes back to it unchanged (part names, label bindings, typesetting and wire crossings, parameter text, text typography, parameters the netlist does not print, unnamed parts, symbol variants, Cell names, the top Cell).

Analog Canvas’s own package, not part of the standard series: its look variants, its chopper and its quartz crystal, and definitions of meaning only that bring a file it writes back to it unchanged (part names, label bindings, typesetting and wire crossings, parameter text, text typography, parameters the netlist does not print, unnamed parts, symbol variants, Cell names, the top Cell).

Analog Canvas’s own package, not part of the standard series: its look variants, its chopper, its quartz crystal and twelve more of its parts (polarized capacitor, LED, Schottky, Shockley, PUT, UJT, potentiometer, photoresistor, speaker, microphone, sine source, ammeter), and definitions of meaning only that bring a file it writes back to it unchanged (part names, label bindings, typesetting and wire crossings, parameter text, text typography, parameters the netlist does not print, unnamed parts, symbol variants, Cell names, the top Cell).

Analog Canvas’s own package for the language 0.4: its look variants of standard symbols, its four-input gates and four-terminal MOSFETs, and the definitions of meaning only that bring a file it writes back to it unchanged.

summary.zh: 独立符号包：137 个不绑定配色的原理图符号和选用规则，引脚方向与标准库一致；可单独使用或搭配 eda-style。
summary.en: An independent package of 137 schematic symbols and selection rules, with no fixed colors and standard-compatible pin directions; use alone or with eda-style.

An independent package of 133 schematic symbols and selection rules for RNL 0.4, with no fixed colors: pins bind the terminal names of the standard series 0.4, the geometry of 0.1 is kept except that the diodes and the transformer stand upright as in that series, and its rules reach every level; use alone or with eda-style.

summary.zh: 独立样式包：绿色细线、红色符号文字、自动红色端子方块和等宽标签；适用于标准、eda-symbol 和自定义符号，符号几何由所用符号包提供。
summary.en: An independent visual package: green hairlines, red symbol text, automatic red terminal squares and monospaced labels for standard, eda-symbol and custom symbols; geometry comes from the chosen symbol package.

An independent visual package for RNL 0.4: green hairlines, red symbol text, automatic red terminal squares on the pins of instances, grounds and supplies, and monospaced labels, for standard, eda-symbol and custom symbols, with rules that reach every level.

The SkyWater SKY130 PDK symbol package for RNL 0.4: the terminal names of every sky130_fd_pr device family and the kind of its transistors, model rules onto the symbols of the standard series 0.4, and eight symbols for devices with substrate, bulk or shield pins; with or without the PDK models included.
